title: Haplos Ni Milagros
overview: VMX Star Vern Kaye takes on a bold new role as Milagros, a young beautiful faith healer who uses her healing hands to cure Erwin’s problem with his manhood. But when she falls for him, her powers begin to fade. Will she choose love or her gift to heal?
